reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are not something I see on my other bottles, and the no-oxide, known-dose thing is a clear answer to a problem I have. The empty-box guarantee and the launch price make it cheap enough to try once on TikTok Shop.
objection: Why one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? And I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles, so I might not finish the 30 sachets.
